data.title: Mexico Retail Sales Slump, Raising Market Concerns
data.description:
Mexico’s retail sales growth slowed to 2.2% year over year from 3.3% previously, a decline of 1.1 percentage points, or 33.3%.

The result fell 0.5 percentage points short of the 2.7% analyst estimate, signaling weaker consumer demand. Retailers, consumer discretionary stocks and companies tied to domestic spending face near-term pressure, while the softer growth outlook may influence broader market sentiment and policy expectations.

data.title: Netcad Reports 13,000-Share Buyback Transaction
data.description:
Netcad Yazilim A.S. ( (TR:NETCD) ) has provided an update.

Netcad Yazılım A.Ş. said its board-approved share buyback program was established for three months beginning Oct. 19, 2026, with a maximum acquisition of 4 million shares and TL500 million allocated for purchases.

data.title: Sabancı Holding Board Resolves Tayfun Bayazıt Appointment
data.description:
Haci Omer Sabanci Holding A.S. ( (TR:SAHOL) ) has issued an update.

Sabancı Holding’s board resolved under Article 363 of the Turkish Commercial Code to appoint Tayfun Bayazıt, who resigned from an independent board-member position, as Ferda Besli’s replacement, with the appointment to be submitted for approval at the first general assembly. The board also resolved to apply to Türkiye’s Capital Markets Board for a favorable opinion on the independent-board appointment; Besli’s profile includes senior banking experience and ongoing leadership and board roles.

data.description:

data.title: FDA Completes Follow-Up Inspection of Xspray Pharma’s Manufacturer
data.description:
Xspray Pharma AB ( (SE:XSPRAY) ) has provided an update.

The FDA has completed its follow-up inspection of contract manufacturer NerPharMa’s Italian facility. The inspection produced a Form FDA 483 with observations, while NerPharMa confirmed that none specifically refer to Xspray’s manufacturing lines or production of Dasynoc® or Nilopki®.

NerPharMa has begun work to address the observations. The FDA has not yet determined the facility’s inspection classification, and the manufacturing site’s regulatory status remains unresolved.

data.title: Genius Group Reports Anthropic IPO and AI Treasury Holdings
data.description:
Genius Group Limited ( (GNS) ) just unveiled an update.

Genius Group is a global education group focused on AI-powered education and acceleration solutions for the future of work. Its offerings include AI training, tools and talent delivered through Genius City and an online marketplace to individual, enterprise and government users in more than 100 countries.

On November 20, 2026, the company updated shareholders after Anthropic’s November 19 Nasdaq listing, reporting that Anthropic represented about 21% of its AI Treasury and was its largest look-through holding. Anthropic’s IPO valued the company at approximately $1.5 trillion, while Genius Group’s holdings also included OpenAI, SpaceX and Databricks.

data.description:
